meta.question: Checking what happens when two imbue items are put on the same ability: do both work, does the last one replace the first, or is the second refused?
meta.purpose: decides how 56 of 81 builds should use their imbue items: 56 builds put 2-5 imbue items on one ability (104 item placements would be unused if the game allows only one per ability)
meta.mechanics: game data (abilities.vdata) gives each imbue item a behaviour type (ACTIVE / ACTIVE_NON_ULT / MODIFIER_VALUE) but no per-ability capacity field; replace vs refuse vs stack is not in the data (UNRESOLVED). Sleep Dagger is used because both effects are readable: Compress Cooldown shows in the ability cooldown (cds), Surge of Power adds imbued Spirit Power (ImbuedTechPower 28 x damage scale 2.2 = +61.6 dagger damage before resists, MODELLED)
meta.feeds: novel hypothesis N01 (imbue capacity); council/evidence/interactions/imbue_audit/IMBUE_AUDIT.txt section C lists the 56 affected builds
meta.prediction_STACK: both effects show in C and D, in either order: dagger cooldown in C/D is about the same as A, and dagger damage is about B (+61.6 over P0)
meta.prediction_REPLACE_LAST: C shows only Surge (damage up, cooldown = P0); D shows only Compress Cooldown (cooldown down, damage = P0): the order of purchase decides
meta.prediction_FIRST_WINS_OR_REFUSE: C shows only Compress Cooldown, D only Surge; the plugin log line for the second imbueown says refused/false/error
meta.prediction_SURGE_GLOBAL: in G dagger damage rises although Surge sits on another ability: then its Spirit Power is not ability-bound and must be valued as a flat stat
meta.decision_rule: STACK: keep all builds, model adds the effects. REPLACE or REFUSE: every build with 2+ imbue items on one ability loses the extra items (IMBUE_AUDIT.txt section C): re-split the imbues across abilities or drop the surplus items, builds owner proposes through the gate. Mixed (same-type refused, different-type stacks): this file cannot separate it (needs a duration readback), record as PARTIAL

meta.unresolved_if: cooldown readback is garbage (cds reports end=0 or values above 1000 s) in P0: INVALID, report the raw cds lines
meta.selection_reason: independent theorycraft: largest build exposure of any open question (56 of 81 builds) and no capacity field in the game data, so the answer cannot be reasoned out
meta.alternative_reason: P0 and single-imbue arms A, B are the controls; C vs D tests order; G tests whether Surge is bound to its ability
meta.rotation: P0, A, B, C, D, G then the same arms in reverse order, P0 last (bracketing control); one Sleep Dagger cast per block, 350u
meta.cond_activations: imbueown for each item, Sleep Dagger
meta.player_expect: Both work, or one is lost
meta.result_says: WORKS (stack) if C and D show both effects; DOES NOT WORK if only one effect shows or the second imbueown is refused; the order of C and D says which one survives
